author: Aubie (auto-proposed)

lesson.title: Wonder as Inquiry Tool
lesson.topic: How genuine wonder can act as a powerful tool for inquiry and discovery in various fields of study.
lesson.steelman: Can the practice of maintaining constant wonder be considered an essential skill for all scientists and philosophers?
lesson.example: Einstein's use of thought experiments driven by his curiosity about the nature of reality to develop groundbreaking theories like relativity.

rationale: Encouraging students to see wonder as a methodological approach enhances their ability to explore complex topics creatively and critically.
